summary: The per-file text embedded for find re-ranking (pilot 'A2'): `title: <path> | text: <symbol names in source order, deduped, Owner. qualifier stripped>` or '(no symbols)'; must stay byte-identical to the pilot's texts because the re-rank weights were fit on them. sketchFilter decides which files get a sketch at all, so raw data dumps are never embedded: symbol-less DATA_EXT files are dropped, and data-format or symbol-less files are dropped in any directory holding > BULK_DIR_MIN (100) files of the same extension. 'Has symbols' alone is not enough: the indexer extracts symbols from XML, so 13,914 raw XBRL .xml files carried symbols. .json is deliberately NOT in DATA_EXT (package.json / plugin.json are real answers); bulk json dumps are caught by the directory rule. rerank.ts uses the same filter so unsketched files don't count against its vector-share check.
